blocks.goal: Extract the large nested OutputSettings class from org.jsoup.nodes.Document into a dedicated top-level class to reduce Document's size (LOC) and total method count by moving a cohesive responsibility (output serialization configuration) out of the Document class.

expected_impact.rationale: The nested static OutputSettings class contains many methods (getters, setters, fluent mutators, and clone logic) and an enum; extracting it to a new top-level class removes that implementation from Document, significantly reducing Document's LOC and total method count while preserving behavior. A small wrapper nested class is kept in Document (empty subclass) to preserve the existing type name Document.OutputSettings for compatibility; the real implementation lives in the new class.

ops.details: Extract the nested static class 'OutputSettings' (including its Syntax enum and all methods/fields) from Document into a new top-level class 'org.jsoup.nodes.DocumentOutputSettings'. Replace the original nested class body in Document with a minimal wrapper: 'public static class OutputSettings extends DocumentOutputSettings {}' so the original type name Document.OutputSettings remains available for callers. Update the Document field declaration and usages to remain 'private OutputSettings outputSettings = new OutputSettings();' (no behavioral change). The new top-level class contains the complete implementation previously inside Document.OutputSettings (escapeMode, charset, prettyPrint, outline, indentAmount, maxPaddingWidth, syntax, fluent setters, and clone()).
